scope.summary: Keeps initial keyboard focus normal, announces in-app route changes from the incoming page heading, and makes the operator shell usable at narrow and long desktop viewports.
out_of_scope: Unrelated audit control layout and visual semantic token repairs

entry_points.name: browser shell behavior
entry_points.trace: `cd web && npm exec playwright test e2e/ux-shell.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts` exited 0 with 2 Chromium tests. It proves initial load leaves the heading unfocused, a client-side route change focuses the incoming heading, the 280px document has no horizontal overflow and a 44px review action, and the desktop sidebar remains onscreen after scrolling Reviews.

limitations: This is local browser coverage and does not claim screen-reader testing with a live assistive technology stack.
No fuzzing or mutation campaign was run.
